CanBeGeneratedByModifiers.rationale: `=> false` (Greed.cs:10) == the class attribute -- correctly mapped here, unlike card/disintegration and card/frantic_escape, where the sim set this flag in place of CanBeGeneratedInCombat.

CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ Eternal, Unplayable }` (Greed.cs:12-16) == both flags. No Ethereal on either side.

ctor.issue: CURSE / CURSE / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier and keeps reporting -1; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges -- `GetAmountToSpend()` clamps to 0 on both sides. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1` (relics/mummified_hand.py:25, potions.py:168, cards/event_cards.py:328), and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses.

OnPlay.rationale: Greed.cs has no members beyond the three overrides -- no OnPlay, no OnTurnEndInHand, no vars, and (unlike card/debt, the other gold-themed curse) no gold effect at all. It is a pure dead draw on both sides.
